projects.name: GameFarm
projects.text: Real Android phones playing mobile games on their own, to collect market and monetization data. I built the gameplay loop and the GCP infrastructure from scratch, then scaled it from one phone to 72 across six countries.

projects.name: Talos 1.1
projects.text: AI video security for bank branches. I fine-tuned an 8B Qwen vision-language model into Talos 1.1, the model that decides whether what a camera sees is an incident.

projects.name: patch-it
projects.text: When a third-party API, package or SDK changes, patch-it finds the code that breaks and drafts the pull request that fixes it, for a person to review. I lead product: the vision, the roadmap and the business model.

projects.name: InfraChat
projects.text: Cited Q&A over the Kubernetes and Docker docs, tested on 87 questions, including trap questions it should refuse to answer.

more.name: QLoRA fine-tuning
more.text: LoRA and QLoRA from scratch on GPT-2 and GPT-Neo, training under 1% of the parameters. Perplexity on Wikitext dropped from 54.3 to 31.6.
